title: Simultaneous Busemann-Petty and Shephard Volume Comparisons
summary: We study the simultaneous Busemann-Petty and Shephard volume comparison problem: whether comparison of the volumes of all central hyperplane sections and all orthogonal hyperplane projections determines the ordering of the volumes of two convex bodies. For every $n\geq5$, we construct origin-symmetric convex bodies of revolution $K,L\subset {\mathbb R}^n$ such that every central hyperplane section and every orthogonal hyperplane projection of $K$ has strictly smaller volume than the corresponding section or projection of $L$, while $|K|>|L|$.
